research_question: Will the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem ever be solved?
central_conclusion: The surveyed evidence supports weak existence, partial regularity, critical continuation criteria, quantitative concentration constraints, and special-case global results. It does not support declaring the unrestricted 3D Navier-Stokes problem solved. Recent public solution declarations remain claims under audit.

evidence.discovery_method: OpenAlex and AnySearch dual-engine search with metadata cross-matching.

human_review_required: Verify official Clay status and bibliographic details through official pages when the requested browser connection is restored.
Obtain independent PDE review of any claimed critical-envelope decay, pressure-tail absorption, compactness, or ancient-solution rigidity result.
If finite computation is introduced later, require an independently implemented certificate verifier.
